page_title: UNI 3-1 MON | Union Berlin v B. Monchengladbach 17/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) was quite harsh and Tobias Reichel didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
89' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
84' Tobias Reichel blows for a foul after Jan Urbich (B. Monchengladbach) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

81' 3 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Moritz Nicolas. 3:1.
80' Eugen Polanski has decided to make a change. Jan Urbich (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Philipp Sander.
78' The ball is out of play and Union Berlin manage to earn a corner.
76' Ilyas Ansah will be replaced by Alex Kral (Union Berlin).
75' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) for his blatant foul.
72' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) replacing Derrick Kohn.
69' Substitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Tim Skarke walks off.
68' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
66' Tobias Reichel has a clear sight and sees a foul from Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin).
62' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
60' That will be all from Florian Neuhaus who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
60' The game has come to an end for Jens Castrop. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach).
60' Here is a change. Yannik Engelhardt is going off and Eugen Polanski gives the last tactical orders to Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach).
60' Substitution. Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) has come on for Kevin Diks.
59' B. Monchengladbach have a goal ruled out for offside!
59' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

58' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. B. Monchengladbach win a corner.
56' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
55' It looks like Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Reichel won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
54' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

53' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.
53' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tobias Reichel blows for a foul. Union Berlin will take a free kick.
51' The resulting corner from Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
49' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Tobias Reichel has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Reichel no option but to blow his whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but it's cleared.
41' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
39' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Janik Haberer.
37' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
36' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
36' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
33' 2 - 1 Goal! Yannik Engelhardt plays a pass to the feet of Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 2:1.

29' A pass travels right across the box to Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow denies him with a decent save.
29' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

29' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' 2 - 0 Goal! Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 2:0.
26' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) takes a shot from inside the box and hits the right post!
25' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Reichel saw the whole situation.
24' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin). B. Monchengladbach have a free kick.
23' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) makes a strong challenge and Tobias Reichel blows for a foul.
21' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
18' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner with a short pass.

17' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, B. Monchengladbach are going to take it.

15' Ambitious effort from Tim Skarke (Union Berlin). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
14' An attempted cross from Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.

10' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and attempts to finish from the edge of the box. His shot, however, misses the target narrowly wide of the right post.
10' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

9' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
7' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
6' The corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is intercepted by Moritz Nicolas.

3' 1 - 0 Christopher Trimmel sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin), who outjumps the defence to finish into the top left corner with a header. The score is 1:0.
3' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) will take a corner kick.

2' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Moritz Nicolas guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
B. Monchengladbach will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tobias Reichel.
